sloka: न तेन जन्म प्रभृति दृष्ट पूर्वम् तपस्विना ।स्त्री वा पुमान् वा यच्च अन्यत् सत्त्वम् नगर राष्ट्रजम् ॥१-१०-९॥
transliteration: na tena janma prabhṛti dṛṣṭa pūrvam tapasvinā ।strī vā pumān vā yacca anyat sattvam nagara rāṣṭrajam ॥1-10-9॥

translations.english: He (Rsyasringa) was always content and never stirred out of his father's hermitage. Absorbed in penance he had never seen a woman or a man nor any of the creatures born in towns or cities right from his birth.
